serviceName: Mojobase email: free the domain from its old provider
description: Adds the TXT record at _osrs_he that frees the domain's email from another provider on OpenSRS (hostedemail.com), so Mojobase can host it. This deletes the domain's email service, mailboxes and mail at that other provider.
variableDescription: dnskey: Mojobase's OpenSRS company DNS key, published to release a domain held by another OpenSRS reseller.
